title: CFMOTO Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The electronic power steering (EPS) can malfunction and cause the rider to lose control of the vehicle, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 2,050.

title: Kidde Recalls TruSense Smoke and Combination Smoke/Carbon Monoxide Alarms Due to Risk of Failure to Alert Consumers to a Fire
summary: The smoke alarm and the combination smoke/carbon monoxide (CO) alarm can fail to alert consumers to a fire. Units: About 226,000.

title: Kolcraft Reannounces Recall of Inclined Sleeper Accessory and Urges Consumers to Act Now to Prevent Risk of Suffocation
summary: Infant fatalities have been reported with other manufacturers' inclined sleep products, after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side, or under other circumstances. Units: About 51,000 (The original recall was announced in February 2020.).

title: Peloton Recalls Tread Treadmills Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The touchscreen on the treadmill can detach and fall, posing a risk of injury to consumers. Units: About 1,050 (In addition, about 5,400 in Canada).

title: Peloton Recalls Tread+ Treadmills After One Child Died and More than 70 Incidents Reported
summary: Adult users, children, pets and objects can be pulled underneath the rear of the treadmill, posing a risk of injury or death. Units: About 125,000.

title: Scott Fetzer Consumer Brands Recalls Multi-Use Water Pumps Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: If water gets into the electrical circuit board, it can short circuit, posing fire, burn and electrical shock hazards. Units: About 42,000.

title: Signature Hardware Recalls Towel Grab Bars Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The product can break, if the towel bar is used to provide bodily support, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 330 (In addition, about 5 were sold in Canada).

title: TJX Recalls Infant Sleep Bags Due to Suffocation Risk; Sold at T.J. Maxx, Marshalls and Sierra
summary: The size of the neck opening is too large for infants 0 to 6 months, which can allow an infant's head to slip into and be covered by the sleep bag, posing a risk of suffocation. Units: About 3,600 (In addition, about 33,250 were sold in Canada.).

title: TJX Recalls Outdoor Wooden Folding Chairs Due to Fall and Injury Hazards; Sold at T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, HomeGoods and Sierra
summary: The chairs can break, posing fall and injury hazards to the user. Units: About 92,000.

title: John Deere Recalls Gator Utility Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: An error in the ECU (Engine Control Unit) software can result in the speedometer and several speed-related safety systems not functioning as designed, posing a crash hazard and risk of injury. Units: About 90.

title: Cheyenne Products Recalls Folding Chairs and Barstools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The weld attaching the legs to the seat bottom can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 795,000.

title: IKEA Recalls Bowls, Plates, and Mugs Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The bowls, plates, and mugs can become brittle and break, causing hot food or liquid to leak out, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 148,000 (In addition, about 11,400 were sold in Canada).

title: BRP Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The snowmobile's muffler can overheat and cause the upper right-hand vent grill to melt and drip plastic on the exhaust, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,400 (In addition, about 3,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Leisure Time Products Recalls Brutus Swing Sets Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The attachment that connects the swing hanger to the top tube can fail, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 9,000 (In addition, about 270 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls RZR Recreational Off-Road Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicles were manufactured without copper seal washers on the turbocharger’s oil supply line, which can result in an oil leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 32.

title: The Lye Guy Recalls Sodium and Potassium Hydroxide Products Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement and Violation of FHSA Labeling (Recall Alert)
summary: The products contain sodium and potassium hydroxide, which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). title: Briggs & Stratton Recalls YTL, Longli and TIYA Log Splitters with Briggs & Stratton® Engines Due to Injury Hazard
summary: An incorrect engine ignition coil and flywheel can lead to hard starting and engine kick back, posing an injury hazard to the operator. Units: About 19,630 (In addition, 362 were sold in Canada).

title: K & M International Recalls Slap Watches Due to Coin Cell Battery Ingestion and Choking Hazards
summary: The coin cell battery inside the slap watches can fall out, posing battery ingestion and choking hazards to young children. Units: About 463,000 (In addition, about 75,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Pool and Patio Umbrellas Recalled Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The umbrella arm can break at the elbow while in use, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 250 (200 of the pool and patio umbrellas were previously recalled on October 25, 2018.).

title: Williams Advanced Materials & Chemicals Recalls Three Chemical Products Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Packaging Requirement and Violation of FHSA Labeling Requirement (Recall Alert)

title: Ergobaby Recalls METROUS Strollers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The button on some buckles that release the harness can break and detach when pressed by the user while the child is in the stroller, making it difficult to release, and posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,800.

title: HSN Recalls 5.4 Million Handheld Clothing Steamers Due to Serious Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled clothing steamers can expel, spray, or leak hot water during use, posing a serious burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 5.4 million (In addition, 14,300 were distributed in Canada).

title: JCPenney Recalls Girls Puffer Jackets Due to Entanglement Hazard
summary: The puffer jackets have a drawstring located inside the lining of the bottom area of the garment. The drawstring can become entangled or caught on playground slides, handrails, school bus doors or other moving objects, posing an entanglement hazard to children. Units: About 3,700.

title: Target Recalls Shower Stools Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The shower stools can become unstable or slippery while in use, causing the stools to tip over, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 58,500.

title: Trek Recalls Bontrager Satellite City Bicycle Pedals Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: If the recalled pedals are incorrectly installed by the retailer during assembly, they can fall off the crank arm of the bicycle, posing fall and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 368,000 (In addition, about 33,540 in Canada).
